name: Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Plant Stake
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 1-layer mirror acrylic, offering a sleek, elegant, and eye-catching decorative finish.
    - Made from 3mm thick mirror acrylic, providing a lightweight yet sturdy structure.
    - Available in Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic options.
    - The reflective surface creates a luxurious and modern appearance, making the piece stand out beautifully when displayed in plant pots, flower arrangements, and garden beds.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Product size: 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Production  Technology:
    - Finished with precision laser cutting and engraving technology.
    - Available in two style options:
                +) Cut Out: Laser-cut precisely according to the shape of the design file.
               +) Engrave: Laser-cut to shape and engraved on the back side of the mirror acrylic.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    -Functions as a decorative plant stake — designed to be inserted directly into soil in plant pots, flower pots, garden beds, or floral arrangements.
    - Perfect for indoor plants, potted flowers, succulents, window sill displays, and decorative vases.
    - Suitable for home décor, garden décor, event centerpieces, and themed party decorations.
    - The pointed stake base holds the piece securely upright in soil without additional support.
    - Adds a stylish, modern, and personalized touch to any plant display or floral arrangement.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
     - A meaningful personalized gift for plant lovers, teachers, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
     - Perfect for birthdays, holidays, baby showers, bridal showers, garden parties, appreciation gifts, and special occasions.
     - Ideal for anyone who loves elegant personalized décor and reflective acrylic keepsakes.
     - Great for event centerpiece décor, celebration displays, and meaningful personalized gifts.
     - Adds a sleek, stylish, and memorable touch to any floral or plant arrangement. 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Plant Stake

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
